scope: Native configured-key auto-load for Fetch/Pull/Push and remote browsing, encrypted response retry and owned cancellation/agent cleanup.

verification.source: Pinned PullFetchDlg/PushDlg auto-load defaults and repository/mode preferences, AppUtils selected/all-remote loading reviewed. Private OpenSSH agent replaces Pageant; native key config remains separate from Windows PuTTY.
verification.core: 13 targeted SSHAgentSession (4), SSHAskpass (3), SSHTransportPreparation (6) tests pass with system Git. Earlier checkpoints cover bundled Core preparation; no broad new second-engine Core claim.
verification.native: Hidden actual models pass with system and bundled Git: wrong/correct encrypted responses, same-key dedup, replaced-key reload, mock scope balancing, Cancel/token/coordinator forced closure, CRLF encryption headers, ordinary invalid-header classification, Fetch/Pull/Push/browse auto-load snapshots and real local Git effects. Actual Push controller closes while awaiting a prompt: no transport or late result; prompt cleared and coordinator closed.
verification.regressions: Existing native Fetch/Pull/Fetch-before-Rebase and Push cancellation receivers pass with both Git versions, including optional No/Yes, owned helper/process termination, unrelated-process survival, retained HEAD/index and partial publication, fresh-token retries and idle Cancel.
verification.debug: Final unsigned Debug build passed. Existing unrelated Swift warnings remain.
verification.appstore: Final unsigned AppStore build passed; both embedded NOTICE files match root. Missing bundled OpenSSH remains a runtime feature gate, not build failure.
verification.bundles: Both audits pass: embedded Finder, Git/LFS where configured, EditorConfig, IssueRegex, askpass provenance/system linkage and 99 original icons. Signed helper inheritance remains unverified.
verification.inventory: Pinned inventory regression passed; partial mappings updated for AppUtils/PullFetchDlg/PushDlg.
verification.workflow: Safe YAML parse and exactly one new native coordinator step passed; hosted CI unavailable/unverified.
verification.site: Local static site build passed; no new screenshots or hosted deployment verification.

limitations: AppStore auto-load remains disabled without bundled OpenSSH agent/add. Signed sandbox inheritance, real bookmarks and real network authentication are not verified.
Keychain, PPK conversion, host-key/password prompts and remaining SSH consumers (Clone/submodules/tags/deletions/Sync) remain pending.
Hidden receivers do not prove displayed sheets, focus, keyboard, long filenames, light/dark, VoiceOver or all-dialog parity.
Blank OpenSSH askpass failures use a bounded encrypted-header recognizer, not a complete key parser. Loader diagnostics use invocation-local LC_ALL=C.
Dedup uses file metadata, not a cryptographic fingerprint; metadata-preserving changes, parent-path races and all suspended config/ref races are not exhaustively verified.
Source Pageant return values can be ignored; native grant/key/load errors and Cancel abort transport. Earlier pushes and saved config remain retained.
No main app launch, user-key/login-agent access, real server, GitHub push, hosted CI/deployment or distribution submission.
